profile.subtitleJa: マノアが住んでいたユダ丘陵の町
profile.summaryJa: マノアはツォルア出身のダン人として記されます。記事はツォルアをユダ丘陵の古代町、テル・ツォラ遺跡に結びます。

facts.textJa: サムソンはツォルアとエシュタオルの間で動き始めました。
サムソンの家族は遺体を運び、ツォルアとエシュタオルの間に葬りました。
ダン人はツォルアとエシュタオルから斥候を送りました。
斥候はツォルアとエシュタオルの仲間に戻りました。
ダン人の六百人がツォルアとエシュタオルから出発しました。

profile.modernLocationJa: ソレク渓谷を見下ろす丘のTel Tzoraに比定され、現代のツォラ集落は遺跡近くにあります。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 士師記13:2でマノアの出身地として初出します。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図上の位置は未確定です。表示される場合は従来資料の参考候補です。

wikipedia.title: Zorah

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”
The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
